item.description: Damon Albarn has graced many a stage as a member of both Blur and Gorillaz, but somehow, the Saturday Night Live stage has not been one of them. item.title: Mama Cast
item.description: In 2024, Owen Elliot-Kugell published a memoir about her mother, the Mamas And The Papas' Cass Elliot. Now, the book is getting adapted into a biopic for the big screen.
